description: This file defines the ServiceEcaRule class, which models rules for service event condition-action logic within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for evaluating conditions, executing actions, and managing rule properties.

classes.name: ServiceEcaRule
classes.description: Represents a service event condition-action rule, capable of evaluating conditions and executing actions based on XML configuration.

methods.name: getShortDisplayName
methods.description: Returns a short string combining service and event names for display.

methods.name: getServiceName
methods.description: Returns the name of the service associated with this rule.

methods.name: getEventName
methods.description: Returns the event name associated with this rule.

methods.name: getDefinitionLocation
methods.description: Returns the location where this rule was defined.

methods.name: getEcaActionList
methods.description: Returns a list of actions to execute when conditions are met.

methods.name: getEcaConditionList
methods.description: Returns the list of conditions for this rule.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates conditions and executes actions if conditions are true, considering rule enablement and event type.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the rule is enabled.
